title: Terra Cresta 3D (Japan): preserve BIOS language and avoid CDON
summary: Skip the game's startup language write and change its CDON command to CDOFF.
rationale: The game forces Japanese in the Saturn's battery-backed SMEM and later issues CDON, which conflicts with SAROO's virtual-disc ownership. These guarded edits leave the user's BIOS settings intact and keep the game on the virtual disc.

writes.effect: Replace the SH-2 call to SETSMEM at 06004256 with a NOP; subsequent SMPC calls remain.
writes.reason: The call writes 00 00 00 05 to SMEM, changing the BIOS language to Japanese and overwriting the other SMEM bytes.

writes.effect: Change the game's SMPC command-table entry from CDON to CDOFF.
writes.reason: CDON transfers CD-block ownership away from SAROO's virtual-disc path; CDOFF preserves the game's later command flow without that handoff.
